title: Reports and snapshots in AutoDiag
keywords: autodiag report reports markdown snapshot snapshots export share ticket redact redacted salt json
text: dds-autodiag check --report report.md (or the dashboard button Download report) writes a Markdown report with the findings, for a ticket or a colleague. dds-autodiag collect -o host.json (dashboard: Export snapshot) saves the environment as JSON; --redact replaces hostnames, IP addresses and home paths with short hashes, and the same --salt on both machines keeps redacted snapshots comparable.
